title: Annual Load Pricing on Small Business Electricity Supply Renewals
content:
**Rule.** On a Small Business Electricity Supply renewal accepted on or before the contract end date, the kWh of the agreement's energy lines posted in the 12 months before the handling date are added up; 150000 kWh or more take 0.30 cents per kWh off the renewal rate; at least 100000 but under 150000 kWh take 0.15 cents off; under 100000 kWh take nothing off. For this count a line falls in those 12 months when fewer than 12 whole months separate its posted date from the handling date.

| kWh on energy lines posted in the 12 months before the handling date | Annual load adjustment |
|---|---|
| 150000 or more | 0.30 cents per kWh off |
| 100000 to 149999 | 0.15 cents per kWh off |
| under 100000 | nothing off |

**Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical totals)**

| Total kWh | Adjustment |
|---|---|
| 99999 | nothing off |
| 100000 | 0.15 cents off |
| 149999 | 0.15 cents off |
| 150000 | 0.30 cents off |

**What is added up.** Only energy lines count, and only those of the agreement being renewed; service fee, tax, fee and credit lines carry no kWh. A hypothetical agreement whose twelve energy lines in the window billed 9800 kWh each totals 117600 kWh and takes 0.15 cents per kWh off.
